purpose: Working learned-controlled PushT validation, three existing layouts on one known scene; no optimizer or broad generalization claim
selection: All three existing layouts, fixed order island/bar/gate, same known source scene; no case or seed replacement
accounting: All executed actions, resets, physics, frozen world-model queries, learned predictions and wall time
release_criteria: Each episode must complete the original joint pusher/block goal with no full-pusher hazard/arena margin breach; reference prediction forbidden
limitations: One known task scene; independent motion predictions were tested on twelve other source scenes, not a broad task-success benchmark
name: pusht-learned-motion-e2e-v1-island
